countingNotes: The 618 discovery cases count final cumulative manifest rows, not unique deduplicated mechanics, independent schema fields or verified implementation defects.
The 30 conflict records exclude Starships of the Galaxy because its final ledger uses a different conflict schema; do not claim this as a project-wide conflict total.
No ship was newly certified in this checkpoint. All findings are static evidence/audit results, not proof of live Foundry behavior.

runtimeRiskFindings.title: Negative weapon bonuses clamped to zero
runtimeRiskFindings.observation: Text parser converts the extracted attack bonus using `+${Math.max(0, bonus)}`; a printed -2 is converted to +0.
runtimeRiskFindings.implication: Must preserve signed published values, with no authority inferred from reparsed output.

runtimeRiskFindings.title: Unknown weapon arc in targeting logic
runtimeRiskFindings.observation: inFireArc defaults `arc='forward'`; any unsupported arc falls through to `return true`.
runtimeRiskFindings.implication: Unknown/source-silent arc is not the same as forward or unrestricted firing; target eligibility needs an explicit policy and failure status.

runtimeRiskFindings.title: Source-silent stats can become defaults
runtimeRiskFindings.observation: safeNumber coerces invalid numeric inputs to a default 0; the broader normalizer is designed to coerce legacy values for rendering.
runtimeRiskFindings.implication: Authority ingest must have an evidence-aware strict stage before display/legacy normalization; do not modify current live Actor behavior based on this static observation alone.

runtimeRiskFindings.title: Crew station resolution already distinguishes ambiguity
runtimeRiskFindings.observation: Explicit station keys win; missing role mapping becomes `unmapped`; multiple role matches become `ambiguous` rather than choosing a gunner.
runtimeRiskFindings.implication: Reuse this existing fail-closed station resolver when vehicle weapon mounts are reconciled.

runtimeRiskFindings.title: Shipyard data uses default shields and weapon rows
runtimeRiskFindings.observation: Build logic reads a fallback 0 shield rating, derives shipyard weapons and preserves existing hyperdrive strings.
runtimeRiskFindings.implication: Separate canonical stock data certification from mutable shipyard build state; do not treat this as proof production currently ingests the new audit ledger.

runtimeRiskFindings.title: Crew-scoped gunnery authority already exists
runtimeRiskFindings.observation: Vehicle attack math distinguishes resolved gunner BAB from vehicle Intelligence and separates abstract crew quality.
runtimeRiskFindings.implication: Reuse the attack-math authority rather than storing printed stock crew bonuses as intrinsic weapon bonuses.

proposedDecisions.title: Reconcile two omitted printed starships
proposedDecisions.recommendationText: Approve a corrective, append-only supplemental census that raises publication-claim scope from 316 to 318 *after* independent source close-read and stable ID checks for Deep-X Explorer and Hornet-class Interceptor. Keep the historical 316 Phase 1 file immutable; do not add narrative-only configurations as ship identities.
proposedDecisions.why: Both have independent published CL statblocks and were omitted from the historical roster. Changing the frozen Phase 1 file would destroy provenance.

proposedDecisions.title: Unknown mounts, arcs, and attack groups
proposedDecisions.recommendationText: Approve two-stage certification: (a) source-complete fact/attack-group record where all printed fields are reconciled and explicit silence is documented, (b) operationally certified only when target/crew rules have sufficient evidence. Never invent physical mount counts or fire arcs; a missing arc blocks automatic arc-dependent eligibility, with a clearly logged GM override allowed at runtime.
proposedDecisions.why: 700 attack-group rows are not 700 physical mounts. The runtime currently has a forward-arc default and an unknown-arc permissive fallthrough; neither should decide canonical silence.

proposedDecisions.title: Resolve contradictory printed rules
proposedDecisions.recommendationText: Keep all conflicting literal printed values with page/field provenance and a PUBLISHED_CONFLICT flag. Do not choose a canonical numeric result without published errata or a separately approved adjudication. Permit a temporary, recorded GM choice for a game instance; it must not mutate the canonical claim.
proposedDecisions.why: At least 30 conflicts are documented outside the Starships of the Galaxy book, including bonus discrepancies and ambiguous hardware lines.

constraints: Single Source of Truth: compiled consumer reads designated authority, no duplicate fallback calculation as a second authority.
No legacy backfill, source fabrication, unconditional variant collapse, or attack-group-to-mount cardinality inference.
Do not mark Phase2C frozen or Phase3 hydration approved.
